intro: Five articles tagged patch-guidance span 2026-05-18 to 2026-09-18, covering vulnerabilities that touch technology, government, AI/ML, critical infrastructure, and federal government. The highest-severity flaws include CVE-2026-60004 and CVE-2026-7301, both rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-8954 and CVE-2026-8959 at CVSS 9.6. A medium-severity issue, CVE-2026-9082, carries a CVSS score of 6.5. The severity mix across the coverage comprises three critical vulnerabilities and one medium. Affected regions named in the reporting include Europe, Global, North America, and the United States.
